INSTRUCTIONS: Copy this file, rename it, edit params.
Reference in a run file as: sensors/SSR/my_SSR

PARAM_DOCS.rpm: Must match co-located PSR for synchronized scanning.
PARAM_DOCS.pd: 0.99 — SSR uses cooperative transponder, very reliable.
PARAM_DOCS.far: 1e-7 — very low, transponder replies are discrete.
PARAM_DOCS.rangeLimits: 120nm — transponder has own TX, longer range than PSR.
PARAM_DOCS.refRCS: Reference RCS (m^2). SSR uses transponder, not skin return.

name: Secondary Surveillance Radar (MSSR/IFF)
